claims.claim: The k-core is the maximum subgraph in which every retained vertex has at least k neighbors in that subgraph.
NetworkX k_core requires a graph without self loops or parallel edges.
The seven-node teaching graph has 1-core size 7, 2-core size 5 and empty 3-core.
claims.locator: Derived by exhaustive peeling and independent NetworkX oracle on explicit edge list
